newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bourse closed August 1 for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bourse closed August 1 for holiday.

text.p: 0715 GMT - Swiss bourse trade was closed for a holiday on Friday, and will reopen on Monday.
On Thursday shares were lower as investors took profits before the three-day weekend in Switzerland.
The blue-chip Swiss Market Index (SMI) fell 31.3 points, or 0.53 percent, to 5,898.2 and the all-share Swiss Performance Index (SPI) ended down 15.31 points or 0.41 percent at 3,752.66.
